contents.value: Taking the time to think about the struggles someone faces enables an individual to have more compassion. It doesn't take a lot to help someone, it's all up to you! It's important to visualize change in your mind, especially positive change not negative change. Visualize the change and decide to help someone with their struggles today. Understanding is a huge force to helping!
